answer: One fake identity costs 50 POA plus a forge stamp, but the tenth costs far more. To dock at the wharf, each identity leases a numbered berth for one epoch, posting a 50 POA bond and a timber token stamped by a licensed forge; every forge publishes its stamps in a public log and charges 5n squared POA for the nth stamp issued to one sponsor in an epoch. A berth renews only if its identity completed attested work last epoch, and idle berths expire, losing 10 percent of the bond per idle epoch. Ten fakes cost 500 POA in bonds plus 1,925 POA in stamps, 2,425 POA against 250 POA of rewards.
